Exact grid-based reference-posterior check (Stage-0 SS11)

Source: R/validation.R
reference_posterior_check.Rd

Compares a lens's posterior to an exact reference computed by dense grid integration of the same unnormalised log-posterior — a reference that is independent of any sampler and needs no external engine, so it is runnable in this standalone package. Feasible only for low-dimensional models (the grid is the product over parameters); for larger models it returns a structured "not applicable" record rather than a misleading number (I1).

Usage

reference_posterior_check(
  fit,
  log_post_unnorm,
  grid,
  tol = 0.15,
  max_cells = 2e+05
)

Arguments

fit

A contributed koine_fb_fit from the lens under test.

log_post_unnorm

A function (theta) -> numeric: the lens's unnormalised log-posterior (likelihood + prior) at a named parameter vector on the draw scale (the same variable names the fit's draws carry).

grid

A named list of numeric grid vectors, one per parameter, naming the parameters in draw-scale order.

tol

Maximum tolerated absolute standardised discrepancy between the lens and reference posterior mean (in reference SDs) for a pass.

max_cells

Refuse (return not-applicable) above this many grid cells.

Value

A list with applicable (logical), and when applicable reference and lens summaries (per-parameter mean and SD), discrepancy (per parameter, in reference SDs), and passed.

Examples

# \donttest{
setup <- koine_lens_validation_setup(
  "dram", n_obs = 30L,
  fit_control = list(n_iter = 1500L, n_burn = 750L, n_chains = 2L))
g <- setup$generate(1L)
fit <- setup$fit_fn(g$pass)
ref <- setup$reference(g, n_pts = 21L)
reference_posterior_check(fit, ref$log_post_unnorm, ref$grid)$passed
#> [1] TRUE
# }
